news.headline: SCBPL profit drops 29% in 1HCY26
news.summary: Standard Chartered Bank (Pakistan) Limited (PSX: SCBPL) reported a 29% year-on-year profit decline for the half year ended June 30, 2026, per Mettis Global's latest-news feed (direct article URL not resolved this cycle; prior comparable-period searches returned FY25/1HCY25 figures, not this 1HCY26 figure - flagged for confirmation next cycle). No absolute profit figure captured this cycle. Logged as impact 4 (material earnings decline, per desk criteria Rule 10) for this core-tier constituent; escalation flagged.

news.source: MM News / PSX Data Portal (DPS) indices
news.headline: KSE-100 opens the week higher after a bearish prior week, easing back by late morning
news.summary: Per MM News, KSE-100 surged 814.94 points to 177,981.46 at 9:35am PKT Monday Aug 24, 2026, rebounding from Friday Aug 21's confirmed close of 177,166.52 (already logged) after a week MM News says shed nearly 2,938 points, moved within a 5,048-point band (high 181,158, low 176,110), lost Rs247bn in market cap, on volume of 4.22bn shares worth Rs205bn. Per dps.psx.com.pk/indices, the page timestamped 'Aug 24, 2026 11:39 AM' shows the gain eased to +562.16 points (+0.32%) at 177,728.68 by late morning. Sub-1% net move so far; logged as impact 3 (notable), consistent with prior similar-magnitude intraday entries in this newslog. Tagged MACRO only; no company-specific driver named in either source.

news.headline: Govt raises petrol price by Rs3.81, HSD by Rs3.59 per litre, effective through Aug 24
news.summary: Per Dawn.com and Business Recorder, OGRA under the government's daily petroleum pricing mechanism raised petrol by Rs3.81/litre to Rs341.59/litre and High-Speed Diesel (HSD) by Rs3.59/litre to Rs368.29/litre, rates effective Saturday Aug 22 through Monday Aug 24, 2026. Follows the already-logged Aug 21 adjustment (petrol +Rs0.27, HSD +Rs1.64). Logged as impact 2 (minor, routine daily adjustment under the new mechanism) - modest magnitude versus the Aug 20 sharp diesel cut already logged at impact 4.

news.headline: Moody's upgrades Pakistan's sovereign credit rating to B3 from Caa1, stable outlook
news.summary: Moody's Ratings upgraded Pakistan's sovereign credit rating to B3 from Caa1 on Aug 24, 2026, maintaining a stable outlook, citing stronger governance and sustained improvement in external/fiscal position; FX reserves rose to about $17bn end-July 2026 (from $14bn a year earlier, near 3 months of import cover), and Moody's External Vulnerability Indicator improved to ~145% in 2026 from ~230% in 2025. Follows S&P's upgrade of Pakistan to 'B' from 'B-' about a month earlier. Logged as impact 4 (material macro/sovereign-rating event per Rule 10); escalation flagged.

news.source: Business Recorder / Mettis Global (PSX Closing Bell)
news.headline: PSX: KSE-100 closes in red, loses 200 points
news.summary: Supersedes the already-logged Aug 24, 2026 11:39am DPS intraday checkpoint (177,728.68, +562.16pts/+0.32%, MACRO only). KSE-100 confirmed close Monday Aug 24, 2026 at 176,966.68, down 199.84 points (-0.11%) from Friday Aug 21's confirmed close of 177,166.52 (already logged). Intraday high 178,122.87, low 176,735.57 - index initially surged over 800 points at the open (per the already-logged MM News item) before selling pressure intensified in the afternoon. Mettis Global's 'PSX Closing Bell: A Shade Lower' confirms the same closing figure. Sub-1% net move; tagged to the union of the superseded item's tickers (MACRO only, no company-specific tickers in that item). Impact 3 (notable), consistent with prior similar-magnitude index-close entries.

news.source: Radio Pakistan / Profit (Pakistan Today) / Bloom Pakistan
news.headline: Cabinet Committee on Privatisation approves restructuring plan for FESCO, GEPCO, IESCO
news.summary: The Cabinet Committee on Privatisation, chaired by Deputy PM/FM Ishaq Dar, approved the Restructuring Plan for Batch-I power distribution companies (FESCO, GEPCO, IESCO) on Aug 22, 2026: land assets to be carved out to the government-owned Power Holding Company, with a government-owned SPV to carve out selected assets/liabilities of the three DISCOs, implemented via a Scheme of Arrangement to be filed with SECP. Expression-of-Interest deadlines: FESCO Aug 7, GEPCO Aug 21, IESCO Sept 7, 2026. Relates to the already-logged Aug 20 item that JDW Sugar Mills (JDWS) was approached to join a FESCO privatisation-bid consortium; no bid outcome or transaction value yet. Logged as impact 3 (notable sector/privatisation-process news; no confirmed transaction for a listed company).

news.source: PSX Data Portal (DPS) indices / Business Recorder
news.headline: KSE-100 closes higher after volatile Moody's-driven session
news.summary: KSE-100 confirmed close Tue Aug 25, 2026 at 177,370.70, up 404.02 points (+0.23%) from Monday Aug 24's confirmed close of 176,966.68 (already logged), per dps.psx.com.pk/indices (page timestamped Aug 25, 2026 5:27 PM: KSE-30 52,827.24 +182.71/+0.35%, KMI-30 251,579.93 +64.12/+0.03%, All Share 107,716.19 +116.44/+0.11%). Per Business Recorder, the session opened sharply higher (+649.91pts to 177,616.59) on Moody's Aug 24 upgrade of Pakistan's sovereign rating to B3 from Caa1 (already logged), fell to an intraday low of 176,577.14 on mid-session profit-taking, then recovered to close near the day's high. Sub-1% net move; impact 3 (notable), consistent with prior similar-magnitude index-close entries in this newslog. Tagged MACRO only.

news.headline: Sapphire Fibres secures RSOQ for GEPCO privatisation
news.summary: Sapphire Fibres Limited (PSX: SFL) secured the Request for Statement of Qualification (RSOQ) issued by the Privatisation Commission for the divestment of the Gujranwala Electric Power Company (GEPCO), per Mettis Global. The company's Board approved participation in the transaction; relates to the already-logged Aug 22 item on the Cabinet's approved FESCO/GEPCO/IESCO restructuring plan. No bid amount or consortium partners disclosed. Logged as impact 2 (minor company item - early-stage bid qualification, not a confirmed transaction).

news.headline: Pakistan rupee records gain against US dollar
news.summary: The Pakistani rupee closed marginally higher against the US dollar on Tuesday Aug 25, 2026, appreciating 0.01% (+Re0.03) to close at 277.52/USD, per Business Recorder. Negligible single-day FX move; logged as impact 1 (routine).

news.headline: Govt introduces performance-based rebate scheme to boost exports
news.summary: Government of Pakistan introduced a performance-based rebate scheme for goods/services exporters effective July 1, 2026: exporters with annual export growth up to 10% get a rebate of 1% of incremental exports, above 10% growth gets 2%; 75% paid provisionally each quarter, remainder settled after fiscal year-end, with clawback if annual exports are flat/decline. Broad sector-wide (export-oriented) policy item; no single-company figure disclosed. Logged as impact 2 (minor, administrative economic policy).

news.headline: Govt unveils simplest-ever tax scheme for small shopkeepers
news.summary: The FBR held an awareness session on its new Small Shopkeepers/Retailer Scheme, requiring a 1% turnover tax and offering simplified registration and flexible payment options, per Mettis Global (published Aug 25, 2026 9:37am PKT). Routine administrative tax-policy item, no listed-company-specific impact. Logged as impact 1 (routine/administrative).

news.headline: PSX to remain closed Wednesday, August 26, 2026 for Eid Milad-un-Nabi
news.summary: Pakistan Stock Exchange issued an official notice (and the federal government declared a nationwide public holiday, approved by PM Shehbaz Sharif) that PSX will remain closed Wednesday, August 26, 2026 for Eid Milad-un-Nabi (12th Rabi ul Awal); SBP separately confirmed it will also be closed that day. state/calendar.json's holidays list (last verified 2026-07-13) does not currently include 2026-08-26 - flagged for the desk to update, since News Sentinel does not have write access to calendar.json this cycle. Logged as impact 1 (routine/administrative calendar notice).

news.headline: Pakistan eyes $1-2bn return to global capital markets
news.summary: Per Mettis Global, Pakistan is targeting $1-2bn in borrowing from global debt markets during the current fiscal year and preparing bond issuances arranged by consortiums including Standard Chartered and Citi, alongside a proposed $10bn US swap line (Finance Minister Aurangzeb - relates to the already-logged Aug 19 $10bn Exchange Stabilisation Support Facility request) intended as a confidence signal for investors. Also cites a planned $750m panda bond (renminbi) issuance and potential Boeing aircraft financing benefiting Pakistan International Airlines. FY26 trade deficit put at $39.5bn (four-year high); total outstanding external debt $129.7bn as of 2024, 23% owed to China. No transaction confirmed or priced yet - pending plans. Logged as impact 3 (notable macro financing development, not yet a confirmed deal), per desk criteria Rule 10.

news.source: Business Recorder / Geo News / Daily Pakistan
news.headline: Petrol price rises Rs1.12, HSD by Rs1.11 per litre, effective Aug 26-27
news.summary: Per an OGRA notification issued Tuesday under the daily petroleum-pricing mechanism, petrol rose Rs1.12/litre to Rs343.10/litre and High-Speed Diesel (HSD) rose Rs1.11/litre to Rs371.80/litre, effective Aug 26-27, 2026 (PSX/SBP closed Aug 26 for Eid Milad-un-Nabi, already logged). Dealer margins fixed at Rs9.98/litre on both products; Petroleum Levy Rs80/litre on each. Follows the already-logged Aug 24 adjustment (petrol +Rs3.81, HSD +Rs3.59). Logged as impact 2 (minor, routine daily adjustment), consistent with prior similarly small moves under this mechanism.

news.headline: PSX shrugs off uncertainty as Asim Munir's Iran visit revives US-Tehran de-escalation hopes
news.summary: Additional driver detail for the already-logged Tue Aug 25, 2026 confirmed close (177,370.70/177,370.71, +404.02pts/+0.23%): per Business Recorder and Dawn.com, the session's gain was attributed to renewed hopes of US-Iran de-escalation following Field Marshal Asim Munir's one-day visit to Tehran (meetings with President Pezeshkian and FM Araghchi), with Iranian officials calling the talks a 'valuable diplomatic gain' per Pakistan Today. This geopolitical driver was not previously captured in the newslog entry for this close, which cited only Moody's rating upgrade. No new index figure or ticker; tagged MACRO only, impact 3 consistent with the already-logged close entry.
